description: v0.206.0. What the phone's on-device reader is told and checked against for one document type: the FoundationModels instructions and schema, the section hints, deterministic extractors, rules and the advisory findings to drop. Configuration, never code. Versioned by copy: exactly one Published row per document type; publishing a Draft supersedes the old one, which stays so every Document Validation's config_version can be traced. docs/design/config_flags_triage.md §1.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: Pesticide Label, Receipt, I-9 Document, … — the same value Document Validation's document_type carries.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: document_type + version is unique. The config_version string is "<document_type>@<version>"; the docname is that string.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only publish_extraction_config makes a row Published; the previous Published row becomes Superseded.

fields.label: Config Version
fields.description: "<document_type>@<version>", written by the controller. What a Document Validation records.

fields.label: Config JSON
fields.description: The body, schema version 1: instructions, fields, sections, extractors, rules, advisory_drop, llm. Checked by update_extraction_config before it is written.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Why this version exists — usually the App Feedback it answers.

name: Extraction Config
